_schema: API rate-limit contract for the Gatekeeper (guidelines §5.2). Every limit is read from here; none may be hard-coded. Appendix F Table 19 values are MINIMUMS -- they may be raised by agreement, never lowered.

gmail._remark: Reports are rare and bursts are the real hazard, so the bucket is sized far below the per-minute ceiling. The daily limit is the last line of defence before account suspension.

llm._remark: Trash-talk generation. A provider outage must never cost a sub-game, so the caller falls back to the template provider rather than retrying into the deadline.
